objs.name: document
objs.description: A policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction managed in the system with versioning and lifecycle control

attributes.name: documenttype
attributes.description: The category of document (Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction)

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the document

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status such as Editing, Review, Released, or Out of Force

attributes.name: validfrom
attributes.description: The date from which the document is valid

attributes.name: validuntil
attributes.description: The date until which the document remains valid

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with its main document and subject to versioning

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status aligned with the main document

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the main document's release cycle and without its own release process

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name of the additional information

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The descriptive or supplementary content

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to an existing document that does not affect the current version until implemented

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The description of the proposed change

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status such as Proposed, Scheduled, or Completed

objs.name: validityextensionrequest
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and confirm continued validity of a document

attributes.name: createddate
attributes.description: The date when the request was created

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status such as Pending or Completed

objs.name: overriderequest
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity

attributes.name: createddate
attributes.description: The date when the request was created

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status such as Pending or Completed

objs.name: reactivationrequest
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore an archived document

attributes.name: createddate
attributes.description: The date when the request was created

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status such as Pending or Completed

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with a defined role in the document management process

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, or Releaser

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The user's identifier or name

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: A collection of users with shared access rights and responsibilities

attributes.name: groupname
attributes.description: The name of the user group

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: The purpose or function of the group

evts.name: documentcreated
evts.description: A new document is created in the system with initial metadata and properties

attributes.name: documenttype
attributes.description: The type of document being created

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template used, if any

evts.name: documentedited
evts.description: The content or metadata of a document is modified

attributes.name: changedfield
attributes.description: The specific field or content that was changed

evts.name: authorizationassigned
evts.description: Reader, author, reviewer, or releaser authorizations are assigned to users or groups

attributes.name: authorizationtype
attributes.description: Type of authorization such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, or Releaser

attributes.name: assignedto
attributes.description: The user or group receiving authorization

evts.name: reviewsubmitted
evts.description: A reviewer completes their technical and formal review of the document

attributes.name: reviewerdecision
attributes.description: Approval or rejection of the document

evts.name: documentreleased
evts.description: A document is approved by a releaser and published to authorized readers

attributes.name: releasedversion
attributes.description: The version number of the released document

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of release

evts.name: signatureapplied
evts.description: An electronic signature is applied by a workflow participant (Author, Reviewer, or Releaser)

attributes.name: signedby
attributes.description: The user applying the signature

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role of the signer in the workflow

evts.name: versioncreated
evts.description: A new version of a document is automatically generated due to content or attachment changes

attributes.name: versionnumber
attributes.description: The new version number

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: The reason for version creation (content change, attachment change, etc.)

evts.name: attachmentadded
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document

attributes.name: attachmentname
attributes.description: The name of the attachment

evts.name: attachmentarchived
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the next document version

attributes.name: attachmentname
attributes.description: The name of the archived attachment

evts.name: additionalinfoadded
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting the document version

attributes.name: infotitle
attributes.description: The title of the additional information

evts.name: changeproposalcreated
evts.description: A proposed change to a document is submitted by an authorized user

attributes.name: proposaldescription
attributes.description: Description of the proposed change

evts.name: changeproposalimplemented
evts.description: A proposed change is scheduled for implementation and a new document version is created

attributes.name: proposalid
attributes.description: Identifier of the change proposal

evts.name: validityextensionrequested
evts.description: A validity extension request is automatically generated when a document nears expiration

attributes.name: validuntildate
attributes.description: The original expiration date

evts.name: validityextended
evts.description: A document's validity is confirmed and extended for another period

attributes.name: newvaliduntildate
attributes.description: The new expiration date

evts.name: documentoverridden
evts.description: A document is invalidated and archived due to loss of validity

attributes.name: archiveddate
attributes.description: The date the document was archived

evts.name: documentreactivated
evts.description: An archived document is re-validated and restored with a new version

attributes.name: newversionnumber
attributes.description: The version number of the reactivated document

evts.name: documenttranslated
evts.description: A released document is translated into another language and submitted for review

attributes.name: targetlanguage
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated

evts.name: translationreleased
evts.description: A translated document version is approved and published to readers in the target language

attributes.name: targetlanguage
attributes.description: The language of the released translation

evts.name: acknowledgementrequested
evts.description: Authorized users are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document

attributes.name: documentversion
attributes.description: The version of the document requiring acknowledgement

evts.name: acknowledgementconfirmed
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a document

attributes.name: confirmedby
attributes.description: The user confirming acknowledgement

evts.name: emaildistributed
evts.description: An email notification is sent to users about a newly released document version

attributes.name: recipientgroup
attributes.description: The user group or individual recipients

evts.name: readeraccessgranted
evts.description: Read authorization is automatically granted to users in distribution lists

attributes.name: grantedto
attributes.description: The user or user group receiving access

o2o.description: A document can have multiple attachments; attachments are controlled documents released with their parent document
A document can have multiple additional information items; they are supplementary and not subject to the main document's release cycle
A change proposal belongs to and references a specific document
A validity extension request is linked to a specific document for reviewing its continued validity
An override request is linked to a specific document for invalidation
A reactivation request references a specific archived document to restore it
A user can be a member of one or more user groups
A document's access is controlled through assignment of user groups with specific authorization roles

o2e.description: DocumentCreated event creates and initializes a document object
DocumentEdited event modifies document content or metadata
AuthorizationAssigned event grants access rights to documents for users or groups
ReviewSubmitted event represents a reviewer's action on a document
DocumentReleased event finalizes approval and publication of a document
SignatureApplied event electronically signs a document during workflow
VersionCreated event generates a new version of a document
AttachmentAdded event adds an attachment to a document
AttachmentArchived event marks an attachment for archiving
AdditionalInfoAdded event adds supplementary information to a document
ChangeProposalCreated event submits a proposed modification
ChangeProposalImplemented event schedules a proposal for implementation
ValidityExtensionRequested event generates an automatic request for validity review
ValidityExtended event confirms and extends document validity
DocumentOverridden event invalidates and archives a document
DocumentReactivated event restores an archived document
DocumentTranslated event creates a translated version of a document
TranslationReleased event approves and publishes a translated document
AcknowledgementRequested event sends acknowledgement workflow tasks to users
AcknowledgementConfirmed event records a user's confirmation of document acknowledgement
EmailDistributed event sends email notifications about released documents
ReaderAccessGranted event assigns read authorization to users in distribution lists
